title: Ind-smoothness transports across compatible ring isomorphisms
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, A a commutative S-algebra, B a commutative R-algebra, and e : R ≃+* S and f : A ≃+* B ring isomorphisms satisfying f(algebraMap S A (e(r))) = algebraMap R B r for every r. If A is a small filtered colimit of smooth S-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras], then B is a small filtered colimit of smooth R-algebras, with the same bound on the universe of the indexing category.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Proposition 07CM, scalar transport in the induction step

proof.text: Construct the restriction-of-scalars functor using Algebra.compHom and the unchanged ring homomorphisms. Restriction along the inverse ring equivalence is its inverse; identity ring maps supply unit and counit, using the inverse identities to check algebra compatibility.

Map the given filtered colimit presentation through that explicitly constructed equivalence. Equivalences preserve colimits, so the same filtered index category supplies a colimit presentation of the transported vertex. A term remains smooth because its structure map is the composition of the smooth original structure map with the bijective base ring map: apply RingHom.Smooth.of_bijective and RingHom.Smooth.comp.
The given compatibility identifies f as an algebra isomorphism from the transported vertex to B. Apply CommAlgCat.isoMk and ObjectProperty.prop_of_iso to conclude.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved by the independent second reader; explicit scalar equivalence and Mathlib colimit and smoothness transport.

mathlib_searches.results: No duplicate ind-smooth ring-isomorphism transport theorem. AlgCat.restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv treats noncommutative algebras; ObjectProperty.ind_iff_of_equivalence is a categorical transport lemma. WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.Ind relates morphism and object ind-properties in equal universes; it does not give this transport theorem.

theorem ind_smooth_of_ringEquiv
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    {A B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra S A] [Algebra R B]
    (e : R ≃+* S) (f : A ≃+* B)
    (hf : ∀ r, f (algebraMap S A (e r)) = algebraMap R B r)
    (hA : ObjectProperty.ind.{w} (fun C : CommAlgCat.{v} S ↦ Smooth S C)
      (CommAlgCat.of S A)) :
    ObjectProperty.ind.{w} (fun C : CommAlgCat.{v} R ↦ Smooth R C)
      (CommAlgCat.of R B)
